Name: Sword and Sorcery - A Fantasy Expansion for East Scarp
Author: DestyNova
Description:
[center][/center][left][size=3][/size][/left][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Tw1KkJRH/S-SFinished.png[/img][img]https://i.postimg.cc/2z9x6KCB/Hail-Well-Met.png[/img]

[size=3]Sword & Sorcery is a story about heroes, a magical adventure inspired by the likes of Dungeons & Dragons, Baldur's Gate, Final Fantasy, and Kingdom Hearts! Follow the complex tale of the Coastal Adventurer's Guild as they learn, grow and change thanks to The Farmer's intervention. It starts with a lone tent on the beach, and ends in a battle to save Pelican Town and East Scarp from the remnants of a tragic mining disaster... [/size]

[size=2][b]Dead Dove, Don't Eat: [/b]Sword & Sorcery is exactly what it says on the tin. If you prefer a more earthly/mundane East Scarp, this mod is not for you. [/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nFsGQGLS/Install-New.png[/img]

[size=3]The following mods are [u]required[/u]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url], Lumisteria's Tilesheets ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9599]Indoor[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Outdoor[/url]) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14493]M.E.E.P

[/url]﻿Simply drop the extracted Sword & Sorcery folder into your Mods directory, ensuring you have all of the prerequisites. 

Additionally, there's more content if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url]! It's not required, but [u]highly recommended[/u].

[b]The entire mod is documented in the Player's Handbook, a means of immersive documentation mailed to the player on install. Please utilize it! It will answer any questions you have pertaining to events, skills, items, NPCs, and more![/b]

[u]S&S is fully compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, Visit Mt Vapius, Sunberry Village, and most other content mods.[/u]
[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/JhSJQSh6/Friends.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Sword & Sorcery adds 3 Romanceable NPCs, 2 Befriendable NPCs, 1 Antisocal NPC, and two Fake NPCs via M.E.E.P: [/b]
[/size]
[size=3][u]Mateo[/u] (they/them), the Artificer: Leader of the Coastal Adventurer's Guild, this rogue with a heart of gold will steal your heart away.
[/size][size=3][u]
Hector[/u] (he/she), the Druid: An ornery recluse living in East Scarp's Deep Mountains, this shapeshifter will test how trustworthy you are. [/size]
[size=3][u]
Cirrus[/u] (she/her), the Bard: One of the Ferngill Republic's most famous musicians has come to The Valley, and not just to play keytar. [/size]

[size=3][u]Roslin[/u] (she/her), the Sorcerer: This eccentric magician comes to the Guild with a desperate task; to rescue her partner.[/size]
[size=3]
[u]Dandelion[/u] (she/they), the Paladin: She's met a terrible fate, hasn't she?[/size]

[size=3][u]Solomon[/u] (he/him): No adventuring party is complete without an annoying sidekick; in this case, Roslin's questionable Shadowfolk patron. [/size]

[size=3][u]Emeritus[/u] (he/him) & [u]Book[/u] (she/her): Charming companions who you'll encounter in your adventure, who decide to stick around. [/size]

[size=3]Mateo, Hector, and Cirrus are fully romanceable with over 15 events each with unique content (spouse rooms, patios, kids, powers).
[b]You can unlock each NPC's dating route by selecting (ROMANTIC) rather than (PLATONIC) during their 10h event cutscene, or, if you're SINGLE, during the finale sequence in the Deep Dark. Sword & Sorcery NPCs can not be dated simultaneously due to how the finale works.[/b]
Be forewarned: PolyamorySweet tends to cause issues with NPCs with custom romance mechanics, such as these. 
[/size]
[size=5][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RVsKpWsb/Journey.png[/img][/size]

[size=3][b]Sword & Sorcery is intended to give an RPG feel, and is primarily designed around each major NPC introducing a new skill to The Farmer[/b]. [/size]

[size=3][u]Artificer[/u]: Perfect your sharpshooting skills with a craftable bow and arrows, or master the forge and expand on your smithing know-how. 
[/size]
[size=3][u]Druid[/u]: Master wildshape and take on the form of a stag, doe or wolf. Or, foster ancient plants long since lost to time. 
[/size]
[size=3][u]Bard[/u]: Take on a defensive or offensive focus while using a slew of new musically-themed utility spells. 
[/size]
[size=3][u]Sorcerer[/u]: Pour your efforts into research and collecting elemental essences and learn mysterious new rituals and potion recipes. 
[/size]
[size=3][u]Paladin[/u]: Use your new Offhand Weapon slot to bolster your armor by using a shield and flinging it at your enemies when they get too close. [/size]

[size=3]During the climax of the story, you will experience The Deep Dark; a new 30 floor dungeon twisting dangerously underneath East Scarp with a final boss, custom forage, custom ore, custom tools to be made with aforementioned ore, and very [/size][size=3]challenging custom monsters. If the Dangerous Mines weren't enough for you, try this. [/size][size=3]Have no fear, though! [b]If you're able to light all four candles on Grandpa's Altar, you'll receive a legendary weapon from a renowned hero to aid you in your quests. [/b][/size]

[size=3]This is in addition to: [u]Over a hundred events and thousands of lines of dialogue, new items, weapons, crops, recipes, machines, maps, location messages, fish, extremely dynamic characters with seasonal outfits and overlays, detailed configuration options, crossovers, and more[/u].

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cLCSSLRz/2.png[/img]

My next project is [b]Sword & Sorcery: Final Mix[/b]! The 3.0 update of this mod will include redone/remastered artwork and a more accessible storyline that introduces characters and skills earlier. My goal is to have a beta by November of 2025. You can find progress updates on Discord and Patreon!

[/size][size=3]I'm feeling pretty satisfied with this project so I'm stepping back from it for now, and my Patreon has been unlisted. I likely won't be as responsive to comments, but feel free to leave bug reports in the proper tab. In the case the game/SMAPI updates, I'll pop back in for maintenance! 

If you've enjoyed S&S and a one-time donation is your vibe, a [url=https://ko-fi.com/destynova]Ko-Fi[/url]﻿ is always appreciated! I do not have social media and am currently not avaliable to be reached out to otherwise. [/size]

[size=3]May your cup never be empty, your dice rolls always high, and your adventures never ending.[/size][/size]
